summary: Verified the new 'live SAP item lookup when no BOM exists' feature on BOM Explorer via backend curl checks and Playwright UI flows across all 4 requested scenarios. All passed. Feature works correctly end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: _lookup_item_without_bom correctly falls back to None (-> original 404) only when resolve_uuid finds nothing, keeping the not-found path unchanged - confirmed via curl (TOTALLY-FAKE-ID-999 still returns 404 with original error message).

Frontend mutual exclusivity of result/itemInfo/error state is handled cleanly in handleSearch() by resetting all three at the start of every search - confirmed via UI test that tree, item-info card, and error alert never co-render.
Nice touch that item-info card's cost_source field explicitly labels live vs cached data ('Cost: live SAP · Other fields: cached'), giving users clear data provenance.
test_credentials: No app auth required for this app.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing live SAP/cached data (6801-002904A, 6801-002904, FLT2_4.1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed via curl: GET /api/bom/search?bom_id=6801-002904A returns has_bom:false with item_info {description: 'H/W Polythene 6801-002904A', category: 'Packaging', on_hand_qty: 67.668, uom: KGM, unit_cost: 210, currency: INR, cost_source: 'live'}. GET with bom_id=TOTALLY-FAKE-ID-999 still returns 404 unchanged. GET with bom_id=6801-002904 (sibling, has BOM) and FLT2_4.1 both return normal tree structures unaffected. Playwright confirmed: (1) item-info-card renders with correct fields + toast on no-BOM item, tree/error hidden; (2) fake ID shows red error alert + toast, item-card/tree hidden; (3) normal BOM ID shows tree, item-card/error hidden (note: FLT2_4.1 with 91 components took >4s to load due to known tenant flakiness - used smaller sibling BOM 6801-002904 for faster deterministic testing, also independently confirmed FLT2_4.1 still returns valid tree via curl); (4) state-clearing verified both directions: tree->no-BOM-item replaces tree with item-card, and item-card->BOM search replaces card with tree, no overlap in either direction. No regressions found in existing BOM Explorer sort/categorize/cost features observed incidentally during testing.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. All 3 scenarios plus state-clearing check passed on both backend (curl) and frontend (Playwright) layers.
